title: Cold Call: Scalix Elite
notes: Centre-line flow only. The side branches (objections) live on the Ctrl+0-9 objection keys.

lines.label: Opening
lines.raw: [🐢] [Name], hi [⬇️]. It's Gagan from Scalix Elite [⬇️].

lines.label: If: What is this regarding?
lines.raw: [⚡] It's Gagan from Scalix [⬇️]. It's regarding the operations review for [Name] [⬇️].

lines.label: If: Is he expecting the call?
lines.raw: [🐢] Not personally—his firm was placed on our research shortlist for this quarter's reviews [⬇️]. [⏸️] When is he naturally less busy [🤔]?

lines.label: Greeting & Permission
lines.raw: [🐢] You're not in the middle of a job site right now, are you [🤔]? (or: viewing)

lines.label: The Hook
lines.raw: [🐢] Good [⬇️]. [⏸️] [⚡] I'm reaching out, [Name], because we work with established [Niche] across Denmark—[🐢] to be precise, teams with a strong local reputation [⬇️]. [⏸️] We aren't calling to sell leads or pitch generic marketing [⬇️]. [⏸️] Looking at your projects, I'm assuming you guys run a core crew of roughly 4 to 8 people on site right now [🤔]?

lines.label: The Leak
lines.raw: Got it [⬇️]. Yeah, so [⚡] the reason for the call is that at that team size, most firms leak 40,000 to 80,000 DKK in clean gross profit margin simply because high-ticket calls hit voicemail while the crew is on site [⬇️]. [⏸️] And that's actually just one of the leaks—there are a couple of other leaks which drain time and revenue [⬇️].

lines.label: The Offer
lines.raw: [⚡] So we take a look at how you currently run things [⏸️] to find any possible hidden gaps leaking revenue or taking up too much time [⬇️]. [⏸️] [🐢] Then, before you invest anything, we identify where AI brings meaningful fixes, and put together a customized plan for how to actually implement it in your business [⬇️]. [⏸️] [⚡] And [Name], before committing to anything, [🐢] I'm just looking to find 10 minutes either tomorrow or later this week, just so you can see what that would even look like for you guys [⬇️].

lines.label: Lock the time
lines.raw: [🐢] Awesome. When are you naturally more free—mornings or afternoons [⬇️]?

lines.label: Narrow it
lines.raw: To be precise, would around 12:30 or 15:30 when you're off tools work better [⬇️]?

lines.label: Confirm email
lines.raw: [⚡] Perfect, 15:30 it is [⬇️]. And your best email is just [firstname]@[company domain].dk, right [🤔]?

lines.label: Spell back email
lines.raw: [🐢] Got it—that's [spell back email address slowly], right [🤔]?

lines.label: Sign off
lines.raw: Perfect [⬇️]. [⚡] My assistant will call you 60 minutes before the meeting as a quick reminder, and they will help you get to the meeting without any technical problems. So we'll catch up later, [Name] [⬇️]. [🐢] Take care, have a nice day [⬇️].
